name: The majority voted in favour of keeping the second reading motion unchanged. A [second reading motion](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/) is a motion to agree with the main idea of the bill. This vote was put after the MP for Whitlam [Stephen Jones](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/whitlam/stephen_jones) proposed the following amendment: > *That all words after "That" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"whilst not declining to give the bill a second reading, the House:* > > *(1) calls on the Government to commit to the legislated increase of the superannuation guarantee to 12 per cent; and* > > *(2) notes that the Government's failure to make sure multinationals pay their fair share of tax in Australia is weakening our economy".*
